challenge.title: Identify reproducible inflammatory biomarkers from single-cell RNA-seq

submissions.title: Microglia inflammatory biomarker atlas with reproducible notebooks
submissions.abstract: A single-cell RNA-seq workflow identifies microglia markers with confidence intervals and reproducible notebook evidence.
submissions.methodsSummary: Normalize single-cell RNA sequencing counts, cluster microglia populations, test inflammatory marker enrichment, and validate biomarkers against held-out cohorts.
submissions.deliverableManifest: Notebook pipeline, biomarker table, confidence interval report, reproducibility container, and summary manuscript.

submissions.title: Independent cytokine response model for biomarker nomination
submissions.abstract: A graph-guided model ranks cytokine response markers and validates findings against public tissue atlases.
submissions.methodsSummary: Build a graph model over cytokine pathways, rank candidate biomarkers, test specificity across tissue atlases, and report uncertainty for each marker.
submissions.deliverableManifest: Graph model code, ranked biomarker JSON, validation summary, uncertainty report, and reproducibility notes.

submissions.title: Microglia inflammatory biomarker atlas with reproducible notebooks

submissions.methodsSummary: Normalize single-cell RNA sequencing counts, cluster microglia populations, test inflammatory marker enrichment, and validate biomarkers against held-out cohorts.
submissions.deliverableManifest: Notebook pipeline, biomarker table, confidence interval report, reproducibility container, and summary manuscript.

submissions.title: Longitudinal biomarker stability screen for inflammatory disease
submissions.abstract: A longitudinal validation workflow checks whether nominated markers remain stable across disease stages and instruments.
submissions.methodsSummary: Estimate biomarker stability across longitudinal cohorts, compare instrument batches, and build a reproducibility score for each marker.
submissions.deliverableManifest: Stability scoring script, batch comparison report, reproducibility scorecard, and reviewer evidence packet.
